title: A/R Collection lines keep their details and days past due
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has an invoice due exactly 12 days ago and an unused credit memo created 3 days ago.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Collection" in the left list.
  3. Open customer X's group.
  4. Read the invoice's line.
  5. Read the credit memo's Past due.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • date, type "Invoice", ID, location, due date, Past due 12, Amount, Open balance.

Step 5:

  • 3.

Why this matters: Days past due is what the collector says on the call.
